explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/105, with |A| = n and |B| = n - 3 encoded as A.card = B.card + 3. A and B are disjoint and A is not collinear. The asked-for line through two distinct points of A avoiding B is line[ℝ,p,q] with no point of B on it. The statement is negated because Xichuan's counterexamples disprove the conjecture, as the page reports.
